in_arabic.name: حاجي
in_arabic.long_meaning: حاجي هو الشخص الذي يؤدي فريضة الحج إلى بيت الله الحرام في مكة المكرمة، وهي واحدة من أركان الإسلام الخمسة، الحج هو الركن الخامس من أركان الإسلام، وهو واجب على المسلمين القادرين مرة واحدة في العمر

in_urdu.name: حاجی
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو حج کی فرضی ادا کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حاجی وہ شخص ہے جو حج کی فرضی ادا کرتا ہے، حج اسلام کے پانچ ستونوں میں سے ایک ہے، حج کا سفر مسلموں کے لئے بہت اہم ہے، یہ سفر روحانی صفائی اور اللہ کے ساتھ قربت کے لئے ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हाजी
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो हज की फर्ज अदा करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाजी वह व्यक्ति है जो हज की फर्ज अदा करता है, हज इस्लाम के पांच स्तंभों में से एक है, हज का यात्रा मुसलमानों के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, यह यात्रा आध्यात्मिक शुद्धि और अल्लाह के साथ निकटता के लिए होती है

in_english.name: Haji
in_english.meaning: One who performs the Hajj pilgrimage
in_english.long_meaning: Haji refers to a person who has performed the Hajj, one of the five pillars of Islam, which is a pilgrimage to the holy city of Mecca, Saudi Arabia, the Hajj is a significant spiritual journey for Muslims, symbolizing unity, equality, and devotion to Allah

data.cultural_impact: The title "Haji" holds immense respect and cultural significance in the Islamic community. It symbolizes a person's dedication to their faith and the Islamic pilgrimage to Mecca, also known as Hajj. This title is often used to address someone who has completed the Hajj pilgrimage, signifying their achievement and commitment to their faith. In Islamic cultures, the title is regarded with great respect and admiration.
data.spiritual_significance: The title "Haji" carries deep spiritual significance for a Muslim. It signifies a person's connection to their faith and their dedication to making the journey to Mecca for pilgrimage, one of the Five Pillars of Islam. The act of performing the Hajj is believed to cleanse a person's soul and strengthen their bond with Allah. The title "Haji" serves as a constant reminder of this spiritual journey and connection to their faith.
